items.why: Shares surge more than 30% as investors cheer Jensen Huang's return as CEO, leading the Nasdaq rebound.
Volatility plunges as stocks rebound sharply in the relief rally lifting the major indexes.
Shares leap 13% and retake key levels after a new FSD update was announced.
No single headline; moving with the broader tape.

market_note: Dow, S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures surged amid a relief rally.
summary: Stocks are roaring back in a relief rally, led by Nvidia on Jensen Huang's return as CEO. The Nasdaq is up about 7% and the S&P 500 is rebounding about 5% as buyers step back in.
